proposed_rules.trigger: A thin promotional text line ('Back to School Sale: Save 65%...') sitting inside the hero zone below the nav, above the H1, rather than as a page-wide bar above the nav.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as plain default-content text at the top of the hero section (a marketing line authors can edit/remove per campaign), not as the site-wide knack-announcement-bar (which is specifically above-nav chrome) and not as its own block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) reuse knack-announcement-bar — rejected because that rule's trigger is specifically 'above the nav' global chrome, while this sits below nav inside page content and is campaign-specific, not persistent; (b) a dedicated 'promo-banner' block — rejected as overkill for a single text line with no distinct structure.
